_about: What each model parameter (a column of the Models tab's tables) means, in a sentence or two: shown on hover over its column's name, and kept here for a glossary. From fit_mb_model's docstring (pyolfsysm.mb_model, olfsysm 8634969), olfsysm's olfsysm.hpp comments, and for the KC-remapping queue's own settings, experiments/E10_joint_fit.py (model_experiment_queue) and its command line's help. 'fit_mb_model' marks one of its kwargs; 'queue' one of the queue's fitting scripts' settings.

params.base: The queue's name for the set of fit_mb_model kwargs a model starts from ("bouton": the claw + bouton hemibrain model, with connectome APL weights); those kwargs are the columns of their names.
params.seed: fit_mb_model: seeds the random draw of a random PN->KC wiring (pn2kc_connections 'uniform', 'hemidraw', 'uniform-boutons', ...). No effect with the connectome's wiring ('hemibrain').
params.pn2kc_connections: fit_mb_model: how the PN->KC wiring is made. 'hemibrain': the connectome's. 'uniform-boutons': each KC's n_claws claws each from a random bouton (in proportion to each glomerulus' boutons); 'uniform-glomeruli-boutons': each claw's glomerulus drawn uniformly, then one of its boutons.
params.one_row_per_claw: fit_mb_model: the PN->KC wiring has one row per claw, not per KC (needed for prat_claws, pn_claw_to_apl and claw dynamics).
params.prat_claws: fit_mb_model: claws as Pratyush defined them in the hemibrain (one row per claw). False in the random wirings, whose claws are drawn.
params.prat_boutons: fit_mb_model: each claw's PN bouton kept separately (Pratyush's anatomical boutons), so APL<>PN weights are per bouton.
params.use_connectome_APL_weights: fit_mb_model: APL<>KC (and APL<>bouton) weights from connectome synapse counts, each set normalized to mean 1, then scaled together by tuning (the *_scale parameters). Otherwise one weight for every KC.
params.uniform_apl_weights: fit_mb_model: every per-claw KC<>APL weight and per-bouton PN<>APL weight 1 instead of its synapse count (then scaled by tuning as usual).
params.shuffle_connectome_seed: fit_mb_model: a control for the connectome's identities: with this seed, the claws' inputs are permuted across all claws, and the per-claw and per-bouton APL weights across claws and boutons (totals kept). None: not shuffled.
params.shuffle_apl_pairs: fit_mb_model (with shuffle_connectome_seed): True keeps each claw's (and bouton's) APL-in and APL-out weights together when shuffled; False permutes the four sets independently.
params.input_glomeruli_only: fit_mb_model: the claw x bouton wiring restricted to the glomeruli of the ORN input, before anything else is built from it.
params.pn_claw_to_apl: fit_mb_model (olfsysm): True: APL is driven directly by each claw's input (subthreshold too, after APL's inhibition of the claw), whether or not its KC spikes. False: only a KC's spike sends its claws' input to APL (times wKCAPL).
params.n_spikes_for_response: fit_mb_model: spikes a KC needs to an odor to count as responding (olfsysm's default 1). Sets what the threshold and APL are tuned to (the response rate) and the responses written, not the spiking itself.
params.n_claws: fit_mb_model: claws per KC in a random wiring (7 by default for the uniform-bouton ones). No effect with the connectome's wiring.
params.kc_kc_inh: fit_mb_model: scale of APL-independent KC->KC lateral inhibition (hemibrain KC->KC synapse counts, normalized so a KC's mean total input weight is 1); None or 0: none. The queue's E10-family fits fit it directly (as wKCKC_scale); fit_mb_model's own tuning never changes it.
params.kc_kc_tau: fit_mb_model: time constant (s) of the filtered KC activity driving KC->KC inhibition (olfsysm's default 0.05 if None). Only with kc_kc_inh.
params.claw_thr: fit_mb_model: per-claw threshold: each claw's drive enters its KC's sum as max(drive - claw_thr, 0). None: none.
params.k: queue: exponent of the APL->KC breadth weighting (E12): each KC's APL->KC weight times ((breadth + 1) / mean(breadth + 1))^k, breadth its total APL-off spike count in the base. 0: none.
params.gain: queue: the PN->claw weights of the gain_glomeruli multiplied by this (E27/E28's oracle gain). None: no gain.
params.gain_glomeruli: queue: the glomeruli the gain applies to.
params.apl_drive: queue: what drives APL. 'claws': the claws' summed input (pn_claw_to_apl); 'spikes': KC spikes plus the boutons' rates (E36); 'spikes_only': KC spikes only, bouton->APL at 0 (E37).
params.wiring: queue: the base's claw x bouton wiring re-drawn with this pyolfsysm.wpnkc_shuffles shuffle (E30). None: the connectome's.
params.wiring_seed: queue: the seed of the wiring's re-draw.
params.orn_input: queue: the ORN input replaced by this CSV (E38). None: the lab's.
params.fixed_thr: Tuned. The somatic spike threshold, added to each KC's spontaneous rate. fit_mb_model tunes it so the response rate is the target times target_sparsity_factor_pre_APL (2) before APL is tuned; the queue's E10-family fits fit it directly.
params.fixed_thr_mean: The mean of the KCs' thresholds: the same as fixed_thr, unless thresholds are per KC (e.g. per KC type).
params.thr_factor: queue: fixed_thr over its base's tuned threshold (worked out from fixed_thr).
params.wAPLKC_scale: Tuned. Scale of the APL->KC weights (the normalized connectome weights times it). fit_mb_model tunes it to bring the response rate down to its target; the queue's E10-family fits fit it directly.
params.wAPLKC: fit_mb_model: the APL->KC weight. With connectome APL weights, the same value as wAPLKC_scale (passed as this kwarg).
params.wKCAPL_scale: Tuned. Scale of the KC->APL weights. Moves with wAPLKC_scale (tuning sets it to wAPLKC_scale over the number of KCs; E10-family fits keep it tied).
params.wKCAPL: fit_mb_model: the KC->APL weight; with connectome APL weights, the same value as wKCAPL_scale.
params.wAPLPN_scale: Tuned. Scale of the APL->bouton weights (claw + bouton models). fit_mb_model's tuning moves it with wAPLKC_scale; E10-family fits fit it on its own (at most aplpn_max times the base's).
params.wAPLPN: fit_mb_model: the APL->bouton weight; with connectome APL weights, the same value as wAPLPN_scale.
params.wPNAPL_scale: Tuned. Scale of the bouton->APL weights. Tuning sets it to wAPLPN_scale over the number of boutons; E10-family fits keep it tied to wAPLKC_scale.
params.wPNAPL: fit_mb_model: the bouton->APL weight; with connectome APL weights, the same value as wPNAPL_scale.
params.wKCKC_scale: queue: the KC->KC inhibition scale as fitted: the same as kc_kc_inh.
params.target_rate: The response rate (APL on) the tuning or fit aimed at: fit_mb_model's target_sparsity, or the rate term of an E10-family fit's loss (0.068: the control flies' fraction).
params.init_from: queue: the earlier fit this one started from (its relative threshold and APL factors on this base, and its KC-KC scale).
params.init_params: queue: absolute parameters this fit started from.
params.init_thr: queue: the threshold this fit started from, overriding the rest.
params.base_params: queue: tuned base parameters given as the reference for the bounds and factors (instead of the base's own).
params.kckc0: queue: the KC-KC inhibition scale the fit started from.
params.thr0_factor: queue: the threshold the fit started from, as a factor of the base's.
params.aplpn_max: queue: the fit's bound on the APL->bouton scale, at most this times the base's tuned value (E31).
params.aplpn_fixed: queue: the APL->bouton scale held at this times the base's, not fitted (E31).
params.aplkc_min: queue: the fit's bound on the APL->KC scale, at least this times the base's (E31).
params.loss_variant: queue: the fit's loss. 'base': the APL on and off odor-odor matrices, response rates and their ratio, the block term; 'structure' adds the structure-beyond-ORN terms (E25); 'rho' puts the matrices first (E63); 'apl' adds the APL-effect term (E67).
params.method: queue: the optimizer of the fit (scipy's).
params.maxfev: queue: the fit's most evaluations of the loss.
params.part: queue: the part of its experiment the model was made in.
params.rate_on: Counted from its responses: the fraction of KC-odor pairs responding with APL on.
params.rate_off: Counted from its responses: the fraction responding with APL acutely off (its APL weights 0).
params.n_kcs: The number of KCs in the model.
params.n_glomeruli: The number of PN-side units of the wiring: boutons in the claw + bouton models (389 in the hemibrain's), not glomeruli.
params.tag: Its unique name in its experiment, which its files are named by: often its variant with a prefix (part, threshold, seed, ...).
params.variant: Its name in its experiment's results table; may repeat (e.g. 'retuned' for each seed). The same as its tag for every baseline.
params.source_table: The queue's results table its row was taken from.
params.base_kwargs_json: The base's fit_mb_model kwargs, as JSON (each also its own column).
params.generated: When its experiment's outputs were written.
